Multiple Homes Engulfed by Fires Across UK and US

Fires have destroyed multiple homes and led to hospitalizations in various locations. In the West Midlands, UK, aerial footage showed homes ablaze, with four people hospitalized and a major incident declared. A child was hospitalized after an 'apocalyptic' wildfire in Stourbridge torched multiple homes. In Caerphilly borough, five homes were destroyed by a fire. Separately, a massive fire consumed two homes in Belleville, New Jersey, US.
